failure_summary: A6 fails deterministically on both runs: the servedExplanation never writes "column 4" (it says only "central-column opening"/"central-column move" wrapped in [zone:better-col]) even though the assembled prompt's Decision block states "Better move: column 4 (lands at c4r3)" verbatim and the board confirms col4 is the winning move (visualize 333 -> all opponent scores negative; 332 -> +2 for the opponent at cols 2 and 5); this is a PRODUCTION-FIDELITY run on gpt-5.4-mini, so prompt_confusion here cannot be separated from model capability, and a model-independent secondary is that render_decision.requiredSet is empty and nothing in the render obliges the better column to appear in prose at all.
notes: n_runs=2 (not 5), so no axis was sub-sampled -- A3/A4/G2/G4/G5 were graded on both runs. A6/A1/A2/G7a_offered/G7b_offered copied verbatim from fv_suff_answers_boards_2026-08-06T16-04-29Z_served_mechanical.json (A6 fail, notes 'prose never names column 4'). A6 run0+run1: served prose names no column number; [zone:better-col]->spec col4 highlights it, but the text does not. A7b run0: "the long fight for the diagonal/parity line" is a specific-sounding board object (a line of four) that resolves to nothing -- it is wrapped in no zone and no cells are named; the row's own render_decision.zones.aliases offered ONLY better-col and played-col at run time (no line handle), so the referent could not have been grounded (secondary triage missing_info); it is also orientation-ambiguous, since lostResource.window c2r5-c5r5 is HORIZONTAL and only opponentPunishment.window c2r1..c5r4 is a diagonal -- graded as manufactured specificity under A7 rather than A4, since the phrase is too hedged to be a crisp false claim. A7 run1 passes: "the tough central race"/"the better parity fight" are abstractions, not unresolvable specific referents, and both zone-wrapped phrases resolve. A5 pass both: 2nd person throughout, no field names; bare "parity" is render-supplied vocabulary (L9 text says "via a parity battle") and is not the banned "parity attribution"; A5b is N/A (player===1). G2 pass: the L9 low-confidence guardrail ("hedge -- do not fabricate a crisp cause") is honored on both runs, neither names a culprit square, and both report confidence "low". G3 pass: afterBest/afterPlayed are shown:false only because their tag-sets equal the decision board, and neither answer needed them. G4 pass: no cell is named in prose; key_cells (c3r1-c3r6, c4r1-c4r6) are exactly the two zone columns expanded, i.e. the Condition D display-overlay exception. G6 pass: patternOnAfterBestBoard is null and L9 (deep parity, no isolable culprit, opening frame) is the correct route for win_to_lose at 2 discs. G7 pass: annotationRepairs is empty, guardDiagnostics.failures/strippedSpecs are empty, both emitted handles are in the offered set, and each wraps a phrase matching its role (better-col over "central-column opening"/"central-column move", played-col over "the other column"/"the side move you chose"); no over-wrap. LAYER CAVEAT: the Step 0b prompt re-assembled with today's renderReasonModel.mjs offers 6 zone handles and a 3-handle requiredSet (you-key-square, opp-key-square, you-key-line) that the 2026-08-06 row's own render_decision does NOT contain (aliases=[better-col, played-col], requiredSet=[]); per Step 0 the row's render_decision was used as ground truth for the offered set, and the re-assembled prompt only for what the model was shown.
